pure-announcement.rationale: It is a vendor integration how-to for configuring updates, not a launch, release note or funding announcement.

duplicate.rationale: None of the nearest concepts (protocol lifecycle policy, OSV format, retrieval evals, sync semantics) touches desktop app update distribution.

unfalsifiable.rationale: The claims are reproducible configuration and code steps a reader can execute against Tauri and Anystack.

durability.rationale: It is pinned to Tauri v1's tauri.conf.json updater block (already superseded by Tauri v2's plugin-based updater) and to Anystack's dist.anystack.sh endpoint URLs and filename conventions.

actionability.rationale: Every step is Anystack-plus-Tauri product configuration; only the thin idea of passing a license key as an Authorization header on the update check transfers beyond these two products.

atomicity.rationale: It is one workflow — license-gated auto-updates for a commercial Tauri app via a distribution service — statable in a single paragraph.
